title: rest: metadata rollback coerces toVersion with Number(), so {"toVersion": true} or [2] restores a version and 1.5 answers 404 instead of 400
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location and a live reproduction (finding class (a)).
Reader: the `packages/rest` lane (`meta-item-history-routes.ts`, the `/rollback` handler), next PR touching the metadata history doors.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "metadata rollback toVersion non-integer coerced" → 1 hit, this card only.
reach: public HTTP entry, measured — `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/rollback {"toVersion": true}` answers 200 and reverts the live body on a stock showcase boot.
Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug
QA-source: #25479 · studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

`POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/rollback` coerces a non-integer `toVersion` with `Number(...)` and accepts whatever passes `isFinite && >= 1`:

- `{"toVersion": true}` → 200, "Reverted to version 1". The live body really changes to v1.
- `{"toVersion": [2]}` and `{"toVersion": "2"}` → 200, and the item reverts to v2.
- `{"toVersion": 1.5}` → `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND`. This should be the route's own `400 INVALID_REQUEST`.

The route's own refusal text says `'toVersion' (positive integer) is required`, so a boolean or a one-element array restoring a version is a silent coercion of an input to a destructive door. `/diff` in the same file already reads its numbers through `readDeclaredQueryNumber`.

## Reproduction (stock showcase, admin)

1. Publish a dashboard twice in a writable package, so that history holds v1 and v2.
2. `POST /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME/rollback {"toVersion":true}` → 200. `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/NAME` now serves v1.
3. Re-measured on a separate boot on a view with no history: `{"toVersion":true}` answers `404 "No history row at version 1"`, and `{"toVersion":[2]}` answers `404 "…version 2"`. Both were read as integers. `{"toVersion":"abc"}` → 400.

Measured on `main` 77392e90 (two dashboards, and separately on a view).

## Where

`packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`, rollback handler (around lines 808–811):

```
const toVersionRaw = body.toVersion ?? body.version ?? req.query?.toVersion;
const toVersion = Number(toVersionRaw);
if (!Number.isFinite(toVersion) || toVersion < 1) { …400… }
```

**Expected:** only a positive integer (a JSON number, or a numeric query string) is accepted. Everything else gets `400 INVALID_REQUEST`.
